messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-8471 triggered: rate-limiter-heartbeat missing for shard gpul-02. Severity: P1. Auto-page engaged.
pagerduty: PD-8471 — Unacked — Incident created by incident-bot. Escalation policy: infra-oncall -> infra-lead.
morgan: acked PD-8471. jumping on it — grabbing logs.
lee: seeing a spike in 5xx throttles for the last 60s across tenant-prefixes: customer-A, internal-synth. Canary shows repeated 429 with x-rate-reason=heartbeat-timeout.
sara: confirmed heartbeat stream to gpul-02 is silent. other gpul nodes are fine. workload seems to be stuck on that shard.
ops-oncall: any recent deploys to limiter? I don't see a config rollout in the last 10m.
morgan: no deploys. watchdog shows limiter process restarted 00:03:12 ago (k8s evict). logs show KV store connection flapped right before restart.
lee: rolling iptable-level circuit to route traffic off gpul-02 to gpul-04 as temporary mitigation. I'll push a route patch:
```
kubectl annotate svc/limiter-route reroute=gpul-04 --context=prod
```
ops-oncall: executed. traffic shift started — monitoring.
incident-bot: PD-8471 update: Morgan acknowledged. Escalating to infra-lead in 5m if not resolved.
sara: after routing, end-to-end 429 rate dropped ~95% for impacted tenants. Good immediate mitigation.
morgan: temporary hotfix: increased limiter heartbeat timeout to 10s on gpul replicas to avoid flaky restarts. applied as feature-flag: limiter.heartbeat.timeout=10s
devex-bot: Note — this flag is flagged as runtime-only. Will revert after postmortem.
lee: Customer impact: three customers reported elevated request latency and ~10% error rate for 2m window. No data loss. Support ticket #11234 created.
support-esc: notifying affected customers with explanation + ETA for full recovery. Draft: "We've mitigated a transient throttling issue caused by a node heartbeat failure; a full fix is in progress."
morgan: monitoring PV and KV flaps — looks like external KVS (tenant-mapper) returned brief GC stall then recovered. That triggered limiter restart under current liveness probe.
ops-oncall: opened a temporary suppress rule to avoid noisy PD flapping while we stabilize. suppress until 3752468850.
lee: can we add a fallback to use room-level quota mapper on missing heartbeat? quick patch suggested: return permissive token state for 30s rather than fail closed.
morgan: agreed, patching permissive fallback now.
```
# pseudo
if heartbeat_missing():
  return permissive_quota(30s)
```
incident-bot: PD-8471 note added: mitigation in progress, permissive-fallback enabled.
sara: re-run smoke for top-10 tenants — green. Will keep monitoring for 15m.
ops-oncall: keeping PD suppressed, but please update PD when resolved so we don't drift.
lee: postmortem notes to collect: limiter liveness thresholds, KVS client backoff, PD noise suppression policy, and support comms timeline.
support-esc: sending customer update now.
morgan: leaving a runbook step to add KVS circuit-breaker metric and alert separate from heartbeat.
sara: thanks — if things stay green, I'll hand back to normal ops in 20m and close PD.
incident-bot: PD-8471 resolved by morgan at 3752468249. Auto-note: incident duration ~119s.
pagerduty: PD-8471 — Resolved.
morgan: follow-up task created: #INC-382 add KVS backoff & reduce liveness sensitivity. assign lee.
lee: assigned and will draft the postmortem.
sara: closing loop with support on customer messages and marking affected window. :white_check_mark:
